**Yes — the documents contradict each other on remote work, in several places.** The contradiction scanner records three verified, open conflicts on remote-work topics, and there are further differences it did not flag.

## Flagged conflicts (verified, open)

**1. How many remote days are allowed — three incompatible limits**

| Limit | Source |
|---|---|
| Max **1 day/week** remote; at least 4 office days | [remote_work_policy_v2 § 2. Office Attendance] |
| Max **3 days/week** remote; remaining days at the office | [remote_work_policy_v1 § 2. Remote Work Allowance] |
| Up to **5 days/week** remote; "no mandatory office attendance day" | [ui_check_remote_policy § Remote Work Policy (2026 Revision)] |

The scanner flags the 2026 Revision against v2.0 (contradiction 4) and against v1.0 (contradiction 3), both at 0.99 confidence.

**2. Home-internet reimbursement — different amounts and different receipt rules**

- $50/month stipend for employees remote at least 3 days/week, "requires no receipts" [sample_policy § Policy Number: RW-2025-014. Effective Date: March 1, 2025.]
- $60/month home-internet limit, with an itemized receipt required for each category [expense_policy § 2. Reimbursable Categories]

The scanner flags this as contradiction 5 (confidence 0.96).

## Differences the scanner did not flag, but which the passages show

- **Notice period:** 15 days' written notice to the manager before changing or ending an approved arrangement [remote_work_policy_v1 § 3. Notice Period] versus 30 days in advance through the HR portal, with verbal agreements invalid [remote_work_policy_v2 § 3. Notice Period].
- **Core hours:** reachable 10:00–16:00 local time [remote_work_policy_v1 § 6. Core Hours] versus 09:00–17:00 local time [remote_work_policy_v2 § 6. Core Hours].
- **Equipment:** one-time home-office allowance of INR 25,000 [ui_check_remote_policy § Remote Work Policy (2026 Revision)] versus a one-time equipment budget of $600 [sample_policy § Policy Number: RW-2025-014. Effective Date: March 1, 2025.].
- **Internal inconsistency inside sample_policy:** §1 states a $50 stipend and $600 equipment budget for anyone remote at least 3 days/week, but its own tier table gives Bronze (3 days) $50/mo and $400, Silver (4 days) $60/mo and $600, Gold (5 days) $75/mo and $800 [sample_policy § Policy Number: RW-2025-014. Effective Date: March 1, 2025.].

## What the documents do *not* resolve

They do not establish which remote-work document governs. remote_work_policy_v2 is ACME Hybrid Work Policy v2.0, effective 2025-06-01, and supersedes v1.0 (effective 2024-01-01) by version and effective date — so between those two, the 1-day limit is the later rule. But nothing in the corpus states whether the undated "2026 Revision" supersedes v2.0, so the 1-day versus 5-day question cannot be settled from the documents. That requires confirmation from People Operations.

- [remote_work_policy_v2 § 3. Notice Period]
- [remote_work_policy_v2 § 6. Core Hours]
- [remote_work_policy_v1 § 2. Remote Work Allowance]
- [remote_work_policy_v1 § 3. Notice Period]
- [remote_work_policy_v1 § 6. Core Hours]
- [ui_check_remote_policy § Remote Work Policy (2026 Revision)]
- [sample_policy § Policy Number: RW-2025-014. Effective Date: March 1, 2025.]
- [expense_policy § 2. Reimbursable Categories]
